articles.headline: PANIC GRIPS MODI-SHAH?
articles.blurb: INDIA bloc leaders and supporters marched toward the Supreme Court in New Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, carrying a "MARCH FOR DEMOCRACY" banner amid the opposition's push over voter-roll issues.

articles.headline: INDIA leaders unite, seek SC's intervention in voter deletions
articles.blurb: Opposition INDIA bloc leaders united to seek the Supreme Court's intervention over alleged irregular deletions in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.

articles.headline: Jantar Mantar no longer legal protest site
articles.blurb: Delhi Police removed Jantar Mantar as a designated protest venue, one of the sub-leads on the front page amid the wider agitation over election-roll revisions.

articles.headline: Rahul urges CEC to resign and become approver
articles.blurb: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi urged the Chief Election Commissioner to resign and become an approver, a front-page brief tied to the opposition's election-commission protests.

articles.headline: 2-yr high: Inflation bites hard as Modi govt faces heat
articles.blurb: Retail inflation hit 5.54% in September while food inflation surged to 9.24%, squeezing household budgets ahead of the festive season.

articles.headline: How world media spotlights Modi govt's protest crackdown
articles.blurb: International outlets including The New York Times, The Guardian, Financial Times, Associated Press and The Wall Street Journal reported on the government's response to protests over the election commission and voter rolls.

articles.headline: Skies over Saudi capital empty after deadly Houthi strikes
articles.blurb: Flight operations at Riyadh's international airport were suspended after drone and missile strikes attributed to Houthi rebels.

articles.headline: Economics Nobel to Robert Hall, Woodford
articles.blurb: American economists Robert Hall and Michael Woodford were awarded the economics Nobel for work on stabilization models, the front page reported.

articles.headline: CJP: Dictator has a problem with people protesting
articles.blurb: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke said a dictator had a problem with people protesting after Delhi Police dropped Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site.

articles.headline: HC cancels hike in SC, ST reservation from 18% to 24%
articles.blurb: The Karnataka High Court quashed the state's move to raise Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe reservation from 18% to 24%, holding it breached the overall 50% reservation ceiling.

articles.headline: Leopard mauls 62-year-old farmer to death, sparks protest
articles.blurb: A 62-year-old farmer was killed by a leopard while working in his field in Ramanagara district, prompting local protests over human-wildlife conflict.

articles.headline: Two Andhra women arrested for stealing gold jewellery
articles.blurb: Police in Chitradurga arrested two women from Andhra Pradesh for allegedly stealing gold ornaments from a co-passenger on a KSRTC bus.

articles.headline: 'CAN'T STIFLE OUR VOICES'
articles.blurb: Police detained Congress supporters protesting Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral-roll irregularities at Freedom Park in Bengaluru on Monday.

articles.headline: M'luru in the running for 50-acre cricket hub
articles.blurb: Mangaluru Urban Development Authority and Karnataka State Cricket Association are evaluating government land parcels of about 25–50 acres, including sites near Kenjar, Gurupura bridge and New Mangaluru Port Authority, for a proposed cricket stadium.

articles.headline: Dasara vs exams: Protesting St Agnes students demand festival break
articles.blurb: St Agnes College students protested management's decision to hold examinations during Dasara, with ABVP backing their demand for a festival break.

articles.headline: Drunk-driving Mini Cooper crash kills 3, including M'luru youth
articles.blurb: Three people died in Nedumbassery, Kochi, when a Mini Cooper allegedly driven under the influence by Suhail Sajeer hit a two-wheeler; a Mangaluru youth was among the victims.

articles.headline: Man kills wife over suspected infidelity, arrested in Mangaluru
articles.blurb: Kavoor police arrested a 40-year-old man for allegedly stabbing his wife to death in their rented house at Uruladi Gudde over suspected infidelity.

articles.headline: Rare two-year-old male black leopard trapped in cage
articles.blurb: Forest officials trapped a rare black leopard in Shirlalu village, Belthangady, and planned to release it into protected forest after a health check.

articles.headline: 'Digital arrest' scam strips farmer of ₹1.31 cr
articles.blurb: A 52-year-old farmer from Puttur lost ₹1.31 crore to fraudsters posing as Mumbai Police and ATS officers who claimed he was linked to terrorist money laundering.

articles.headline: Mangaluru Junction steps up cleanliness drive with four-stream waste segregation awareness
articles.blurb: South Western Railway organised a Swachhata Pakhwada drive at Mangaluru Junction, promoting four-stream waste segregation among passengers and staff.

articles.headline: Dipke decries 'mental torture' by police
articles.blurb: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke said he and his family faced mental torture during Delhi Police detention after he was held at Delhi airport on October 10.

articles.headline: Rahul putting 'ultra-Leftist' mindset in India, says Fadnavis
articles.blurb: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis accused Rahul Gandhi of pushing an ultra-Leftist mindset in the country.

articles.headline: MPSC chief going on leave big victory for students: Rahul
articles.blurb: Rahul Gandhi called the Maharashtra Public Service Commission chairman going on leave a victory for students protesting alleged irregularities in recruitment.

articles.headline: Notice against jeweller for fraud
articles.blurb: A special CBI court issued a proclamation against billionaire jeweller Jatin Mehta, his wife and son in a bank fraud case involving ₹146.35 crore.

articles.headline: DEVOTION IN UNISON
articles.blurb: Devotees recited the Sri Suktam collectively during Navaratri celebrations at Mahalaxmi Temple in Pune on Monday.

articles.headline: CM Naidu launches Rs 3,222 cr projects
articles.blurb: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu launched development projects worth ₹3,222 crore in Tirupati, including pilgrim accommodation and city infrastructure.

articles.headline: Ex-security guard 'killed' minor girl in gated community
articles.blurb: Hyderabad police arrested a former security guard for kidnapping and murdering a five-year-old girl; her body was found in a water sump in the gated community's clubhouse.

articles.headline: Two students drown while picking lotus flowers
articles.blurb: Two students drowned in a pond at Uppugundur in Andhra Pradesh while collecting lotus flowers for a festival.

articles.headline: T'gana BJP prez slams Cong over farmer distress
articles.blurb: Telangana BJP president Bandi Sanjay Kumar accused the Congress government of neglecting farmers' issues and the state's agricultural crisis.

articles.headline: Tyeb Mehta's 'Rickshaw Puller' sells for Rs 69.1 crore
articles.blurb: Tyeb Mehta's 2002 painting "Rickshaw Puller" sold for ₹69.1 crore at auction, surpassing his previous record of ₹61.80 crore set by "Trussed Bull".

articles.headline: 25 Cong MLAs, including ministers, will join BJP if polls held now: Vijayendra
articles.blurb: Karnataka BJP leader B Y Vijayendra claimed 25 Congress MLAs, including cabinet ministers, would defect to the BJP if elections were held now, challenging the Congress government on finances and administration.

articles.headline: DKS backs Rahul Gandhi's march to top court
articles.blurb: Deputy Chief Minister D K Shivakumar backed Rahul Gandhi's Delhi march to protect democratic institutions and the sanctity of every vote.

articles.headline: 'Does becoming DC give her horns?' HDK slams Hassan DC
articles.blurb: Union Minister H D Kumaraswamy sharply criticised Hassan Deputy Commissioner over an administrative order involving the Superintendent of Police, questioning her conduct.

articles.headline: Youth Cong, NSUI activists show black flags to Somanna
articles.blurb: Youth Congress and NSUI activists waved black flags at Union Minister V Somanna in Shivamogga protesting alleged irregularities in electoral rolls.

articles.headline: Khandre directs action over delay in wage payments under VB-G RAM-G scheme
articles.blurb: Rural Development Minister Eshwar Khandre ordered show-cause notices over delayed wage payments under rural employment schemes, regretting that workers were migrating in search of work.

articles.headline: SEEKING A BETTER DEAL

articles.headline: BJP Mahila Morcha members detained over harassment protest
articles.blurb: BJP Mahila Morcha members were detained in Bidar while protesting against a Congress MP over allegations of sexual harassment and professional misconduct.

articles.blurb: Veterinarians at the Sakrebayalu elephant camp in Shivamogga treated 30-year-old elephant Drona with a fiberglass cast for a leg fracture sustained in its kraal, described as a first for a large adult elephant in India.

articles.headline: Nobody wants to wait until 2047 for BJP's imaginary Viksit Bharat (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Commentator Sanjay K Jha argues that after a decade in power the Modi-Shah team lacks intellectually sound counter-arguments to public and opposition demands amid Delhi security barricades during CJP protests.

articles.headline: Draconian clampdown against democratic dissent (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The page argues a Delhi lockdown against Cockroach Janta Party protesters challenging the Narendra Modi government and CEC Gyanesh Kumar reflects a design to protect the commissioner through a capital-wide clampdown.

articles.headline: Misleading AI fake videos of Delhi protests
articles.blurb: Truth Trail reports AI-generated visuals are being falsely circulated as genuine footage of protests against the Election Commission.

articles.headline: Modi needs a new slogan, not Viksit Bharat (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Political editor D K Singh writes that Narendra Modi's promise of a $5 trillion economy by 2022 morphed into the Viksit Bharat project and that his speechwriters appear out of fresh ideas.

articles.headline: Karnataka celebrates its pride (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Letter writer Dr Zahiruddin Ahmed of Bengaluru reflects on the state's cultural heritage and recent celebrations.

articles.headline: Rise in dengue cases (Opinion)

articles.headline: Jantar Mantar: Legacy of dissent, testament to democracy

articles.blurb: Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh called the Prime Minister and Home Minister a "poisonous pair" over denotifying Jantar Mantar, saying what matters to them is "demokursi" and signalling extreme panic.

articles.headline: Trade bodies oppose Ramlila Maidan as protest site

articles.headline: 'Unacceptable': CJP on Jantar Mantar being denotified

articles.headline: Cong losing due to its leadership not EC: BJP

articles.headline: AIADMK vote share dips; deepens crisis in party

articles.headline: Aradhana Mona takes over as UP Cong chief

articles.headline: SLEEP & CHILDHOOD TYPE 2 DIABETES What's the connection?

articles.headline: Navratri fasting Balancing faith with good health
articles.blurb: The feature advises devotees to stay hydrated and avoid overeating junk or sweets while fasting during Navaratri.

articles.headline: Unlocking the power of hair rinses for scalp & strand health

articles.headline: Foods that contain more proteins than egg

articles.blurb: Robert E Hall and Michael Woodford won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for research on models that help governments and central banks manage economic shocks.

articles.headline: Skies over Riyadh empty after Houthi airport strikes
articles.blurb: Operations at Riyadh international airport were suspended after Houthi drone and missile strikes.

articles.headline: Countries warn against travel to Saudi Arabia

articles.headline: Energy ceasefire is being violated: Zelenskyy

articles.headline: Lebanon's PM vows probe on explosives
articles.blurb: Lebanese authorities investigated a truck laden with explosives intercepted at the Dahr-el-Baidar checkpoint, allegedly linked to Hezbollah.

articles.headline: 2 merchant ships with 22 Indians attacked
articles.blurb: Two commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz were attacked; MT Petro Dolphin was reportedly hit by a drone and 11 Indian seafarers were missing.

articles.headline: US Senators question legality of Trump's Russian oil imports

articles.headline: France's far-left prez candidate cheers Gen Z
articles.blurb: Jean-Luc Melenchon rallied in support of a high-school protest movement against selective university admissions.

articles.headline: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles in tests

articles.headline: Pope will undergo lung nodule surgery: Vatican
articles.blurb: The Vatican said Pope Francis was scheduled for surgery to remove a lung nodule.

articles.headline: Mittal conferred France's highest civilian award
articles.blurb: Bharti Enterprises chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal received France's Legion d'Honneur.

articles.headline: Cheap is not always the best choice
articles.blurb: A consumer column warns against the bargain trap, urging readers to weigh durability and long-term value beyond the MRP.

articles.headline: Trade body flags online-offline price gap in e-com sales
articles.blurb: Trade body CWBTA flagged concerns over predatory online pricing during festive e-commerce sales compared with offline retailers.

articles.headline: India-EU FTA to make deeper alliance: Czech Min
articles.blurb: A Czech minister said the proposed India-European Union free trade agreement would deepen bilateral ties.

articles.blurb: Puravankara Ltd signed a joint development agreement for a North Bengaluru residential project with about ₹2,500 crore revenue potential.

articles.blurb: The report said India was managing gas supplies to protect city-gas consumers as Strait of Hormuz tensions threatened LNG shipments to South Asia.

articles.headline: They had a plan, but I had to play better than that: Abhishek
articles.blurb: Abhishek Sharma said opponents had a plan against him but he needed to bat better after a T20 against West Indies in Indore.

articles.blurb: Cristiano Ronaldo said he is football's greatest player despite suspension from Portugal's national team after a dispute with manager Jorge Jesus; the page compared career goals, Ballon d'Ors and World Cup records with Lionel Messi.
